stem: Relationships are coded so that in 'X s Y' the symbol s tells how X is related to Y: + means X is the father of Y, - means X is the sister of Y, * means X is the son of Y, and / means X is the mother of Y. Reading the chain P / Q + R - S, how is P related to S?

per_option_rationale.rationale: P / Q decodes to P is the mother of Q, so P is female and a parent of Q. Q + R makes Q the father of R, so R is a child of Q. R - S makes R the sister of S, so S shares R's parent Q. Thus S is a grandchild of P through Q, and P, being female and two generations up, is the grandmother of S.
Mother places P one generation above S. P is the mother of Q, and Q is the parent of both R and S, so P is two generations above S, a grandparent, not a parent.

Grandfather has the right generation but the wrong gender. The symbol / codes mother, so P is female; the female grandparent of S is the grandmother, not the grandfather. Reading / as father causes this slip.
Aunt would make P a sibling of S's parent. P is the mother of S's father Q, so P is in the direct ancestral line two generations up, a grandmother, not an aunt.

explanation: Decode each operator on the left operand and chain the parent links. P / Q means P is the mother of Q, so P is female and a parent of Q. Q + R means Q is the father of R, so R is Q's child. R - S means R is the sister of S, so S shares R's parent, namely Q. Therefore S and R are both children of Q, and Q is a child of P. S is two generations below P, a grandchild, and P is female, so P is the grandmother of S.

explanation_sections.punchline: P / Q reads as 'P is the mother of Q', and the chain puts S two generations below P, so P is the grandmother of S. The trap is decoding / as father.
explanation_sections.approach: Decode each symbol on the left operand: P mother of Q, Q father of R, R sister of S. Build the parent links: P over Q, Q over R, and since R is S's sister, Q over S too. Count generations from S up to P: S to Q is one, Q to P is two, so P is a grandparent. Attach P's gender from the / symbol, which is mother, hence female, giving grandmother. Verify each symbol was decoded in the stated direction, X related to Y.
explanation_sections.lesson: In coded relations decode the symbol as the left person's role toward the right person, then carry both the generation count and the gender to the final label.
explanation_sections.timing: About 145 seconds. Fastest elimination is option (2) Mother: S descends through Q, who is P's own child, so P is one generation too high to be S's mother.
